title: Choose the admin workflow
question: Which structure should Codizzz use for everyday services, careers and team updates?

options.label: Content Control Desk
options.thesis: A calm overview leads into focused resource workspaces without losing context.
options.viewport: A compact left rail, a central status overview for Services, Careers and Team, and a recent-changes ledger with one clear Add action per resource.
options.risk: One extra click is needed before editing a specific record.

options.label: Split Registry
options.thesis: Choose a resource, select an item, and edit it in place across three stable panes.
options.viewport: A narrow resource rail, a sortable item list, and a full-height editor pane with Save, Publish and Delete held in predictable positions.
options.risk: The three-pane layout becomes a two-step drill-down on small screens.

options.label: Command Library
options.thesis: One fast registry makes every service, role and team member searchable and editable from the keyboard.
options.viewport: A prominent search-and-create command strip sits above a unified table; filters isolate each content type and a selected row expands into an inline editor.
options.risk: A unified registry is less visually separated for occasional users.
